meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (via DBIE)

hbs.title: State-wise Credit-Deposit Ratio of Scheduled Commercial Banks - According to Place of Sanction

meta.coverage: State-wise Credit-Deposit Ratio of Scheduled Commercial Banks - According to Place of Sanction: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 153
meta.note: DBIE report 1696, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor). Periods: fiscal years, dated at April. Dimensions: none; measures: state, region. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
